x: Our second man was Len Fletcher, walking in something like his old form; and third for us came Don Brown—an excellent performance. J.
Expense and the difficulties of the long journey may limit our numbers, but we need have no fear that we shall not be represented by a first-class team of eight. Green, Rickards, Bentley, J.

With the New Year, we shall see them back in harness again, preparing for the 20 miles Championship, which has eluded us in recent years, despite some really fine walking on the part of our men. Bentley, Rickards, Bidgood, Martin, J.

Twenty-seven of our own walkers entered—quite good representation—but several of our men who have given such excellent service in past races were still resting; and circumstances precluded the entry of several others who have added lustre to our teams in the past, and will do so again in the future…
